summary: Breaking free from one source of control does not help much if you discover afterward that the replacement now controls the things you still depend on.
body: Breaking free from one source of control does not help much if you discover afterward that the replacement now controls the things you still depend on. When Uranus conjuncts Pluto, disruption can change the balance of power quickly, especially when an old arrangement fails and a new system, person, or option rushes in to take its place. The break itself may be necessary, but freedom is not measured only by what you escaped. Look at what now controls your access, choices, money, or information and make sure the new arrangement actually gives you more room to move.
